h1: Hot taps run, but the water is cold
title: Hot taps run, but the water is cold | G3 Cylinder Help
description: Understand hot taps run, but the water is cold. Distinguish the symptom, gather useful details and arrange competent cylinder assessment in London.
answer: Normal flow with cold water points toward the heat input or its controls rather than automatically proving the cylinder vessel has failed.

sections.heading: What this symptom can mean
paragraphs: For an indirect appliance, the connected boiler and hot-water controls matter. For a direct cylinder, timed supplies, immersion heaters and thermostats may be relevant. The applicable path depends on the installed model.

sections.heading: Information to gather safely
paragraphs: Note whether space heating still works or a normal boost programme changes the symptom. Avoid repeated resets or speculative replacement of the entire cylinder.

sections.heading: How the enquiry becomes an investigation
paragraphs: The cylinder make, full model and heating arrangement should be identified first. The same visible symptom can arise from different causes, and a relief device may be protecting the system rather than creating the original problem. Component testing and any repair belong to a person competent for the work.

sections.heading: Discuss the appropriate next step
paragraphs: Call 020 7205 4433 with the postcode, symptom history and any previous service findings. The enquiry establishes the proposed assessment and availability. Do not use this guide as a substitute for the actual appliance safety instructions or an on-site diagnosis.

faqs.question: Does normal flow with cold water prove that the cylinder needs replacing?
faqs.answer: No. Heat input and control faults can leave a sound cylinder cold; diagnose the heating arrangement before recommending vessel replacement.
